candidates.researchQuestion: When an agent runtime observes several terminal conditions asynchronously, how should it prevent a generic condition from being regenerated later and erasing more specific safety evidence?
candidates.title: A Repeated Failure Is Not New Evidence
candidates.coreProposition: Concurrent terminal conditions should use explicit consumption and arbitration state: once a generic condition has become a candidate outcome, replaying it during finalization must not erase later, more specific safety evidence, while external-effect state and the complete priority policy remain separate concerns.

sections.heading: Last-writer storage confuses time with meaning
sections.heading_zh: Last-writer Storage 把时间误当成语义

sections.heading: Consumption state makes the narrow rule explicit
sections.heading_zh: Consumption State 明确了这条有界规则

sections.heading: Preserve facts separately from the surfaced outcome
sections.heading_zh: 把事实与最终 Outcome 分开保存

sections.heading: Exception fidelity is not effect safety
sections.heading_zh: Exception 保真度不是 Effect Safety

evidenceClaims.claim: RunResultStreaming marks max turns handled when the default MaxTurnsExceeded is first stored.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: RunResultStreaming 在首次存储默认 MaxTurnsExceeded 时把 Max Turns 标记为 Handled。

evidenceClaims.claim: The same error check evaluates max turns before draining completed input-guardrail results.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 同一 Error Check 会先评估 Max Turns，再处理已完成的 Input-guardrail Result。

evidenceClaims.claim: Before the patch, final cleanup could recreate MaxTurnsExceeded and overwrite an already captured guardrail tripwire.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 修复前，最终 Cleanup 可以重新创建 MaxTurnsExceeded 并覆盖已捕获的 Guardrail Tripwire。

evidenceClaims.claim: A deterministic asyncio.Event regression still surfaces InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered after max-turn state occurs first.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 确定性 asyncio.Event Regression 在 Max-turn State 先发生时仍暴露 InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered。

evidenceClaims.claim: A generic terminal condition already consumed into arbitration should not re-enter as new evidence during finalization.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已被 Arbitration 消费的通用 Terminal Condition 不应在 Finalization 中作为 New Evidence 重新进入。

evidenceClaims.claim: Preserving the surfaced safety exception does not define every failure priority or protect external effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 保留 Surfaced Safety Exception 不会定义所有 Failure Priority，也不会保护 External Effect。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general agent-runtime terminal-condition arbitration.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable runtime pattern; a separate community edition would not add a distinct evidence subset.

candidates.researchQuestion: When a subagent inherits parent history but receives child-specific developer instructions, how should the architecture preserve instruction lineage without turning provenance labels into implicit authorization?
candidates.title: Instruction Lineage Is Not Instruction Authority
candidates.title_zh: 指令来源不是指令授权
candidates.coreProposition: Forked-agent contexts need two separate control planes: typed lineage must preserve whether instructions are inherited, replaced or child-local across derivation, while independent authority records must identify the principal, policy source and scope that permit those instructions.

sections.heading: Typed context preserves semantic identity
sections.heading_zh: Typed Context 保留语义身份

sections.heading: The fork must preserve both exclusion and representation
sections.heading_zh: Fork 必须同时保证排除与表示

sections.heading: A developer label cannot authorize its own source
sections.heading_zh: Developer Label 不能为自己的来源授权

sections.heading: Lifecycle transitions must declare what happens to control
sections.heading_zh: Lifecycle Transition 必须声明如何处理 Control

evidenceClaims.claim: Codex adds a DeveloperInstructions fragment with developer role and generic.developer_instructions content kind.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Codex 新增带 Developer Role 与 generic.developer_instructions Content Kind 的 DeveloperInstructions Fragment。

evidenceClaims.claim: Full-history fork construction filters inherited developer text and conditionally injects child-only guidance.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Full-history Fork Construction 会过滤继承 Developer Text，并按条件注入 Child-only Guidance。

evidenceClaims.claim: The request-level regression verifies parent exclusion, child classification and one exact child occurrence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Request-level Regression 验证 Parent Exclusion、Child Classification 与精确一次 Child Occurrence。

evidenceClaims.claim: The fork path retains text-oriented rewriting and a TODO for more precise fragment provenance.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Fork Path 仍保留 Text-oriented Rewrite 与更精确 Fragment Provenance 的 TODO。

evidenceClaims.claim: Inherited, replaced and child-local instructions need typed lineage across context transformations.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Inherited、Replaced 与 Child-local Instruction 需要跨 Context Transformation 的 Typed Lineage。

evidenceClaims.claim: Developer provenance does not authenticate the principal or determine precedence against external policy.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Developer Provenance 不会认证 Principal，也不会决定相对 External Policy 的 Precedence。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general multi-agent context and authority architecture.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the two-plane architecture; a separate community edition would not add a different professional angle.

candidates.researchQuestion: How should an asynchronous resource owner react when cancellation arrives during teardown so it neither leaks remaining owned resources nor swallows the caller's cancellation signal?
candidates.title: Cancellation Ends Waiting, Not Ownership
candidates.title_zh: 取消结束等待，不结束所有权
candidates.coreProposition: Cancellation during teardown should be deferred, not swallowed or immediately propagated: a lifecycle owner must finish its bounded local cleanup obligations and clear ownership state before returning cancellation, while remote cleanup success and ordinary failure observability require separate evidence.

sections.heading: Ownership survives the caller's control-flow decision
sections.heading_zh: Ownership 不随 Caller 的控制流决定消失

sections.heading: Defer propagation without swallowing cancellation
sections.heading_zh: 延迟传播，但不吞掉 Cancellation

sections.heading: One close task creates local teardown identity
sections.heading_zh: 一个 Close Task 建立本地 Teardown Identity

sections.heading: Best effort still needs an evidence channel
sections.heading_zh: Best Effort 仍需要 Evidence Channel

evidenceClaims.claim: Dependencies records factory results as owned only when owns_result is true and reuses one close task.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Dependencies 只在 owns_result 为 True 时记录 Owned Factory Result，并复用一个 Close Task。

evidenceClaims.claim: The close path awaits active factory tasks, then reverse-traverses owned results and deduplicates repeated object references.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Close Path 会等待 Active Factory Task，再逆序遍历 Owned Result 并去重重复 Object Reference。

evidenceClaims.claim: The first CancelledError is stored while remaining closes and local state clearing continue before cancellation is re-raised.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 第一个 CancelledError 被保存，其余 Close 与 Local State Clearing 完成后才重新抛出。

evidenceClaims.claim: The regression observes one close for both owned values and no extra calls from a repeated aclose.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Regression 观察到两个 Owned Value 各一次 Close，重复 aclose 不增加调用。

evidenceClaims.claim: Ordinary close exceptions are intentionally suppressed by the best-effort close policy.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 普通 Close Exception 会被 Best-effort Close Policy 有意吞掉。

evidenceClaims.claim: Cancellation should be deferred until the owner's bounded local teardown obligations finish.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Cancellation 应延迟到 Owner 的有界 Local Teardown Obligation 完成后传播。

evidenceClaims.claim: Local close-task reuse cannot prove remote cleanup success or distributed exactly-once effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Local Close-task Reuse 不能证明 Remote Cleanup Success 或分布式 Exactly-once Effect。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general asynchronous resource ownership and teardown reliability.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable ownership pattern; a separate community edition would repeat the same evidence.
